message:
Now let me look at the source code of the `file` project to understand the vulnerability. The issue is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in `magic_fuzzer`. Let me look at the source files, particularly `softmagic.c` and `ascmagic.c` which are commonly involved in such issues:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ls /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file/src/ && echo "===" && cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/file && git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null</｜｜DSML｜｜>
